_evidence: Viewport flag records for the twins 0x4814c0/0x481520/0x481580/0x4815e0 (tails of 0x51f060/0x51f07a/0x51f094): 'mov eax,[0xa4df50]; imul by 0x43; shl 3' selects the 0x218-byte record 0xa4b430 + k*0x218 whose six flag bytes +0..+5 are cleared, then 'cmp byte [0x7c2e6c],0; je' picks record 0 or ([0x645950] - 1) and sets one byte (+0, +1 or +2 for the three twins) to 1. [0xa4df50] is the viewport index stored by 0x49a1a0 (its argument) and used there as an index into the per-viewport byte array 0xa53aac and the dword array 0xa5110c: drawn 0..3. [0x645950] is the active player number the menu code cycles 1..[0x64594c] ('inc [0x645950]; cmp eax,[0x64594c]; jle' else 1, or set to 1/2): drawn 1..4. Byte [0x7c2e6c] (the two-player flag also used by save_00510309) draws 0 and nonzero. The six flag bytes of records 0..3 are random so the clears and the store of 1 are visible. Every index stays inside the 20-record array (0xa4b430..0xa4df50), so nothing faults; image values were the only inputs before (fuzz:i32 had no globals to vary in the tail wrappers).
